issues.description: The problem statement (Aufgabe 06) requests the count of Wanderwege that lead to Gemeinden with more than 500000 male inhabitants (einwohner_m > 500000). The provided solution query uses the opposite comparison (einwohner_m < 500000), which contradicts the task specification and will produce incorrect results and confuse students following the reference solution.
issues.suggestedFix: Update the solution query to use the correct comparison operator so it matches the problem description: replace 'AND einwohner_m < 500000' with 'AND einwohner_m > 500000' in aufgabe06.sql.
